# Roazon coffee skill

> An installable AI skill for finding specialty coffee from Dutch roasters through Roazon's public read-only search index.

- Install: https://github.com/roazon/skills
- Skill instructions: .agents/skills/roazon-coffee/SKILL.md
- API: GET https://roazon.nl/api/v1/search?q=<url-encoded coffee constraints>
- API schema: openapi.json
- API keys, authenticated search, MCP/OAuth, billing, and ordering are not provided by this package.
- Results may be stale; the API response has no crawl timestamp and does not guarantee live stock or final prices.
